mapper.sql: r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.member_id AS memberId, r.place_id AS placeId, r.visitor_name AS visitorName, r.phone, r.visit_date AS visitDate, r.check_out_date AS checkOutDate, r.headcount, p.place_type AS placeType, r.status, r.order_id AS orderId, r.payment_type AS paymentType, r.pg_tid AS pgTid, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, r.cancel_requested_at AS cancelRequestedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RESERVATION (member_id, place_id, visitor_name, phone, visit_date, check_out_date, headcount, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{placeId}, #{visitorName}, #{phone}, #{visitDate}, #{checkOutDate}, #{headcount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT place_type FROM PLACE WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
SELECT name FROM PLACE WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
SELECT min_price FROM PLACE WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
SELECT FROM RESERVATION r LEFT JOIN PLACE p ON r.place_id = p.place_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}
SELECT FROM RESERVATION r LEFT JOIN PLACE p ON r.place_id = p.place_id WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE RESERVATION SET status = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED', cancel_reason = #{reason}, cancel_requested_at = NOW() WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId}
UPDATE RESERVATION SET status = 'PAID', cancel_reason = NULL, cancel_requested_at = NULL WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM RESERVATION r LEFT JOIN PLACE p ON r.place_id = p.place_id WHERE r.status = #{status} ORDER BY r.cancel_requested_at DESC, r.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM RESERVATION r LEFT JOIN PLACE p ON r.place_id = p.place_id WHERE r.status = 'PENDING' AND r.order_id IS NOT NULL AND r.created_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.update: UPDATE RESERVATION SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND created_at < #{cutoff}
UPDATE RESERVATION SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED' AND COALESCE(check_out_date, visit_date) < CURDATE()
mapper.select: SELECT visit_date AS visitDate, check_out_date AS checkOutDate, headcount AS headcount FROM RESERVATION WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PAID', 'CONFIRMED') AND COALESCE(check_out_date, visit_date) >= CURDATE()
SELECT is_closed FROM PLACE WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
SELECT closed_date FROM PLACE_CLOSED_DATE WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND closed_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY closed_date
